## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `build:`, `ci:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit tests, and TCK cases for anything that changes generated SQL)
- [ ] `./mvnw verify` passes locally
- [ ] Public API changes are documented, and new APIs that may still change are marked `@Incubating`
